column1: # country_facts_v2.tsv — the HAND-WRITTEN input of the v2 country table (DECISIONS, written by us; T6 SOC-PY 2026-09-28).
# tools/v2/build_countries_v2.py reads this + the Wikidata population / GDP-per-capita cache and writes countries_v2.tsv,
# regions_v2.tsv and buckets_v2.tsv. Every alpha-2 code of Locale.Region.isoRegions (data_v2/ios_regions.tsv) has one line
# (US has two rows: east+central and west+mountain); numeric UN M.49 codes resolve to the highest-weight row they contain.
# code  kind   target  std_off_min  bucket  culture_mix  weight_rule  note
#   kind   row = its own board; alias = plays on the target's board (territories, uninhabited places); numeric = a macro-region
#   std_off_min = the standard (winter) UTC offset of the main population centre (IANA tzdata); the model never switches DST
#   bucket = the timezone band whose ONE schedule offset (buckets below) every row is within +-60 min of
#   culture_mix = name cultures drawn per member (M5), weights relative
#   weight_rule = keep:<w> (one of the 49 reference rows: its weight stays) | refit:<w> (re-fitted, calib_v2.py) |
#                 decision:<w> (set by us, reason in the note) | formula (population x per-capita weight of its income class,
#                 see build_countries_v2.py) | formula:<class> (the same, class set by hand where Wikidata has no GDP) |
#                 formula@<M.49 sub-region> (the per-capita weight of another sub-region; the note says why)
